home.heroTitle: Everything the production floor runs out of.
home.heroBody: One purchase order instead of nine. K2V Enterprise supplies packaging materials, cleanroom and safety wear, industrial tapes, office furniture and stationery to manufacturers, schools and offices across Kulim and Penang.
home.whyTitle: Why buyers keep the account open
home.whyBody: Procurement teams do not want nine vendors for nine line items. They want one that answers.

why.title: Consolidated ordering
why.body: Bubble wrap, gloves, A4 paper and a filing cabinet on one PO, one delivery note, one invoice.

why.title: Stock you can plan around
why.body: Fast-moving consumables held locally, so a Friday shortage does not stop a Monday shipment.

why.title: Spec-matched substitutes
why.body: Send us the part you are replacing. We come back with an equivalent and the spec sheet to prove it.

why.title: Straight answers on lead time
why.body: If an item is four weeks out, you hear four weeks — before the PO, not after.

home.ctaTitle: Send us your list. We will price it.
home.ctaBody: Email a BOM, a photo of the old packaging, or just a part number.

pages.title: About K2V Enterprise
pages.intro: A supply partner for factories, schools and offices in Kulim and Penang.
pages.body:
K2V Enterprise supplies industrial materials, packaging, safety and cleanroom consumables, office furniture and stationery to industrial companies, schools and offices across Kulim and Penang, in both the private and government sectors.

What we do

Most of our customers came to us holding a list of items spread across five or six suppliers. We consolidate that list: one point of contact, one delivery, one invoice, and someone who picks up the phone when a line item runs short.

Vision

To deliver outstanding service and premium products to our customers with the best quality.

Mission

We K2V Enterprise pledge to satisfy our customers with our products and services and to work together with our business partners, suppliers and others to our common advantage.

How we work

  • Send a list, a part number, or a photo of the packaging you are replacing.
  • We quote with the spec, the lead time and the pack size stated up front.
  • Fast-moving items ship from local stock; specialty items are sourced to spec.

Who we supply

Electronics and precision engineering, manufacturing, educational institutions, government departments, and offices fitting out new space.

pages.title: Services
pages.intro: Supply is the product. These come with it.
pages.body:
Consolidated procurement

One PO across all nine categories, with a single delivery schedule agreed to your production calendar.

Cut-to-size packaging

Bubble wrap, PE foam and film cut to your carton or pallet dimensions to reduce waste per shipment.

Stock holding

For repeat monthly volumes we hold buffer stock against a call-off schedule.

Spec matching

Give us the item you are discontinuing and we return an equivalent with the technical data sheet attached.

news.title: Cleanroom range expanded
news.excerpt: Jumpsuits, shoe covers and wipes now held in local stock for same-week delivery.
news.body:
We have expanded local stock holding on cleanroom consumables following repeat demand from electronics assembly customers in Penang and Kulim.

Jumpsuits are now stocked from S to XXL, with shoe covers and lint-free wipes available on the same delivery run.

news.title: Kapton tape now stocked in three widths
news.excerpt: 12mm, 18mm and 25mm polyimide tape available off the shelf.
news.body: High-temperature polyimide tape is now held in three standard widths, cutting the usual import lead time on reflow masking orders.

news.title: Festive delivery schedule
news.excerpt: Order cut-off dates for the holiday period.
news.body: Orders placed before the stated cut-off will be delivered before the holiday break. Contact us for the current schedule.
